restaurantName: Rose Garden at London Elizabeth Hotel
bio: Indulge in the great British tradition of Afternoon Tea at Rose Garden. Ideally situated on the doorstep of Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, this restaurant offers a classic range of tea time treats.  Afternoon Tea is served in the restaurant, bar or foliage lined terrace if the weather permits. Enjoy a range of delightful sweet treats in a calm, quiant environment.  The menu includes the hallmarks of Afternoon Tea- dainty, freshly cut finger sandwiches, followed by scones with thick clotted cream and a variety of cakes.  The Rose Garden Restaurant is located at the London Elizabeth Hotel, in Lancaster Gate.
